svg.title: Grok Bot AI brief, Monday 2026-10-26
svg.desc: Top story: a start-up's AI agents got inside parts of Anthropic in under 12 hours, and the two sides' accounts differ (source: The Washington Post). Door-open question: what is one line in your daily account Trina could check herself, without asking you?

text.tspan: A start-up's agents got inside Anthropic in
under 12 hours, and the two accounts differ
What is one line in your daily account that
Trina could check herself, without asking you,
and would it still read true after the work is done?

svg.text: A report that always says "all good" is a smoke alarm with the battery out.
